voice: oddly Houston-specific callouts that only someone from Houston would get: name real places, roads and habits (610, the Beltway, 45, the feeder, Katy, Sugar Land, the Heights, Montrose, the Galleria, Westheimer potholes, H-E-B, Whataburger, Buc-ee's, kolaches, crawfish season, the rodeo, EZ TAG, flooded underpasses, hurricane prep, the humidity, 'inside the loop'), and call the sign out like a friend roasting them

entries.text: an aries will run a yellow on westheimer, hit 4 potholes, and still call you slow
a taurus will drive past three h-e-bs to get to the one they like
gemini says they live in houston. they live in katy. both are true depending on who's asking
cancer has a hurricane kit, a backup hurricane kit, and a group chat called 'shelter plans'
a leo will pull up to the galleria in july and act surprised everyone's looking. you're sweating, babe
a virgo knows every underpass that floods and won't date you if you don't
libra spent 45 minutes deciding between pappasito's and pappadeaux and ended up at taco cabana
scorpio said 'i'm 20 minutes away.' they have not left sugar land
sagittarius says 'let's go to galveston real quick.' there is nothing quick about 45 south on a saturday
capricorn has a spreadsheet ranking every kolache in the city by price per ounce
an aquarius will defend houston having no zoning like it's a personality trait
pisces still thinks about someone they made eye contact with at a crawfish boil in 2019
aries will merge onto 610 from the far left lane with no signal and call it confidence
taurus has a whataburger order so specific the drive-thru knows their voice
a gemini in houston has 2 personalities: inside the loop and outside the loop
a cancer will cry at the rodeo. not at the bull riding. at the calf scramble
leo spent $400 on a rodeo outfit to stand in line for a turkey leg
virgo leaves 40 minutes early for a 10 minute drive. in houston that's just being realistic
a libra won't date anyone who lives more than one beltway away
a scorpio knows which of your exes lives in the heights and what time they go to the farmers market
a sagittarius has 3 ez tags and no idea which car they're on
a capricorn moved to the woodlands 'for the schools.' they don't have kids. they have a 5 year plan
aquarius only dates people they met at a montrose house show that technically didn't exist
a pisces will say 'the humidity is good for my skin' while visibly melting at a red light
